title: MNO Finance v. Ajay Sharma
text: The complainant, MNO Finance, filed this petition under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act against the drawer, Ajay Sharma, for dishonour of three cheques totalling Rs 15,00,000. All three cheques were dishonoured with the remark 'Insufficient Funds'. Demand notices were sent in respect of each cheque. The drawer failed to pay within the statutory period. The complaints were tried together. The drawer raised a plea that the cheques were post-dated and given as security deposits. However, the complainant's ledger showed corresponding loan disbursals for each cheque. Under Section 138 NI Act and the Negotiable Instruments Act, the drawer is held guilty in respect of all three cheques. Consolidated fine of Rs 30,00,000 is imposed. In default, two years simple imprisonment. The complainant is entitled to the cheque amounts as compensation.
